description: This file defines the AuthorizationControl class which manages authorization rules, approval workflows, and validation logic for transactions within the ERPNext system, including user roles, approval hierarchies, and rule validation.

classes.name: AuthorizationControl
classes.description: Class handling authorization rules, approval workflows, and validation for transactions in ERPNext.

methods.name: get_appr_user_role
methods.description: Retrieves approving users and roles based on maximum amount and authorization rules.

methods.name: validate_auth_rule
methods.description: Validates authorization rules based on the transaction amount, type, and context.

methods.name: bifurcate_based_on_type
methods.description: Determines authorization based on user, role, or global rules depending on context.

methods.name: validate_approving_authority
methods.description: Main method to validate if the current user has authority to approve a transaction.

methods.name: get_value_based_rule
methods.description: Fetches the applicable authorization rule based on employee and transaction amount.

methods.name: get_approver_name
methods.description: Retrieves the approver's user or role for specific transaction types like Expense Claim or Appraisal.
